reason: The hypothesis synthesizes the observed strength plateau (P9) and the edge-dislocation control theory (P14, P31) with the concept of local chemical ordering (P42, P45) to propose a specific, testable mechanism: that controlled variation in short-range order directly drives the screw-to-edge transition. This links two separate bodies of literature (mechanical behavior and chemical ordering) through a causal intervention that none of the passages proposes, and it designs a falsification test to resolve the conflicting dislocation interpretations (P15 vs. P14).
